content: Fiye 10:1 Noa’walaŋ Yalakiŋiye Ulihakaaŋ kwetkwet udapmagiŋ
Yoŋ adi Noa mihiŋiye Sem, Ham eŋ Yafet adi’walaŋ mede kahat. Ime gabuŋ wapum dapmaune mindaŋkade Noa mihiŋiye’walaŋ mihiwoi mintagiŋ.
Yafet diniŋ youhabet
Yafet adi’walaŋ mihiŋiye diniŋ wouhiye habet indiŋ: Gome, Magok, Madai, Yawan, Tubali, Mesek eŋ Tilas.
Agaŋ Gome’walaŋ mihiŋiye diniŋ wouhiye youhabet indiŋ Askenasi, Lifat eŋ Togama.
Agaŋ Yawan mihiŋiye’walaŋ wouhiye youhabet indiŋ: Elisa, Tasis, Kitim eŋ Lodanim.

Uŋaniŋ meeniŋ daneeŋ bop molomolom, mede molomolom, naŋgat diki molomolom eŋ wouhik wapum molomolom unduŋ daneeŋ ime luhi gagayeŋ kwet hali ulak uŋandiŋ wooŋ hati taugiŋ. Yafet’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi unduŋ tigiŋ.
Ham diniŋ youhabet
Ham’walaŋ mihiŋiye diniŋ wouhiye habet indiŋ: Kus, Misilaim, Put eŋ Kanaaŋ.
Agaŋ Kus’walaŋ yalakiŋiye diniŋ wouhiye youhabet indiŋ: Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Lama eŋ Sabteka. Eŋ Lama’walaŋ mihiŋiyat lufom adi’walaŋ wouhiyat e indiŋ: Seba eŋ Dedaŋ.
Kus’walaŋ yalakiŋiŋ adi Nimlot mintaguk. Adi kuyeŋ kwet foloŋ mapme loloŋit hatihati u tububihikuk.

Eŋ Wapumdi saŋiniŋ mimbuune fafaŋe tiŋa kale kaliŋ yawooŋ kale mohok widihiluguk doktiŋa metamdi me niŋ wou nintilonene indiŋ niyagiŋ, Me Nimlotdi Wapum’walaŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ kale yakidituguk dabugoŋ hinek eie!
Nimlot adi mapme hatigukneŋ yobune tububihila yokwet wapuhi indiŋ mintataugiŋ. Babilon, Elek, eŋ Akat, yokwet wapuhi i hogohogok adi Babiloniya kwetneŋ ila ugiŋ.
Uŋaniŋ Asilia kwetneŋ wooŋ yobune uŋoŋ maaŋ yokwet wapuhi indiŋ mintagiŋ: Niniwe, Lehobot, Kala
eŋ Lesen woondi Niniwe eŋ Kala adi’walaŋ baŋamhik ginaŋ itak. Yokwet wondi wapum hinek tilak.
Agaŋ Misilaim adi’walaŋ yalakiŋiye bop hatiiŋ indigoŋ tuwot wouhiye indiŋ hatak. Ludihi, Anamihi, Lehabihi, Nafituhi,
Patalusihi, Kafatolihi eŋ Kasiluhi. Adi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋ foloŋ Filisitiahi adi adi ulihaka tigiŋ.
Agaŋ Kanaaŋ adi’walaŋ mihi tuwo adi Sidon eŋ adi’walaŋ sigineŋ mintaguk adi Het tiŋa mebop noli indiŋ.
Jebusahi, Amolahi, Gilgasahi,
Hiwahi, Akahi, Sinihi,
Awadahi, Semalahi eŋ Hamatahi. Bop unduŋ mintaugiŋ. Unduŋ mintatawooŋ mindaŋkade Kanaaŋ’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi mowoŋa kwetkwet indiŋ hatitaugiŋ.
Sidon, Gilakade uŋaniŋ eŋ uge uge Gasa kwetneŋ usuwalak. Agaŋ Sodom, Gomola, Adma uŋaniŋ eŋ uge uge Lasa usuwalak unduku hatitaugiŋ oŋ.
Kaŋ yoŋ adi Ham’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ laŋiye mintaulihakaaŋ wouhik wapum molomolom, eŋ medehik molomolom, eŋ kwethik molomolom unduŋ daneeŋ mowoŋa hati taugiŋ diniŋ kahat.
Fiye 10:21-32 Sem Diniŋ Youhabet
Yafet dali biyeniŋ Sem, Ebe’walaŋ yalakiŋiye diniŋ dadahik.
Sem’walaŋ mihiŋiye mintagiŋ adiniŋ youhabet: Elam, Asu, Afakisat, Lut eŋ Alam.
Alam’walaŋ mihiŋiye: Usi, Huli, Gede eŋ Mesak.
Afakisat adi adi Sela diniŋ beu. Agaŋ Sela adi Ebele diniŋ beu.
Ebele adi mihiŋiŋyat lufom mintagumuk. Mihiŋiŋ niŋ wou Pelek youkuk. Woŋ adi mebi indiŋ, adi’walaŋ nai ginaŋ kwet wapum daneguk. Eŋ adi’walaŋ kwayaŋ diniŋ wou adi Yoktam youkuk.
Yoktam’walaŋ yalakiŋiye indiŋ mintagiŋ. Almoda, Selap, Hasamawe, Yela,
Hadolam, Usal, Dikla,
Obal, Abimael, Seba,
Ofil, Hawila eŋ Yobap. Meheki i hogohogok adi Yoktam’walaŋ mihiŋiye.
Adi yokwet hatigiŋ adi mele labulabuneŋkade kwet haŋgi haŋgi Mesaniŋ tububihila hatibune uge uge Sefala kwetneŋ dapmalak.
Sem’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi wouhik wapum molomolom, medehik molomolom unduŋ daneeŋ mowoŋa hatitaugiŋ.

Noa mihiŋiye’walaŋ yalakihiye unduŋ ulihakaaŋ naŋgat tali molomolom tububihila ugiŋ wondok tuwolit youhabiyetafoŋit. Indiŋ hinek mintaguk ime gabuŋ wapum busuwaguk dapmaune sigineŋ meeniŋ bop mohok kwetkwet hatitaugiŋ adi adi’walahi-ku ulihakagiŋ tilak.
